'''Eighty-second Armored''' was a military unit of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Fel (major)|Fel]] was part of unit until he was caught by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and impsioned on [[A-77 (prison)|A-77]]. He was eventually rescued by [[Havoc Squad]] during the [[A-77 operation]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eighty-second Armored is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Trooper class mission.<ref name="SWTOR" />
